entities.summary: Raj Kumar Gupta is an Indian film writer and director, known for his work in Hindi cinema. He made his directorial debut with the acclaimed Aamir (2008) and has since directed the critically and commercially successful films like No One Killed Jessica (2011), Raid (2018) and Raid 2 (2025).
